Safe Lamp Charge.name: Safe Lamp Charge
Safe Lamp Charge.description: The user feeds a controlled current into a small compatible device, such as a rescue lamp or radio, and keeps it working until the end of the user's next turn. This gives a team light or a brief call when its battery has failed. The device needs a usable contact and cannot accept more than its circuitry allows; excess current burns it out. Strain: moderate.
